description: api-java: Spring Boot 4.0.0 / Java 21 orchestrator. Multipart upload with magic-byte MIME validation + SHA-256, async job orchestration via a Python-service REST client that propagates a correlation-id header, Flyway migrations creating documents/blocks/chunks (pgvector vector column + tsvector full-text column) matching the canonical schema, and a JAVA-ONLY chat/RAG path (hybrid retrieval + RRF rerank + prompt build + LLM call via interface -> answer + citations). LLM and embedding sit behind interfaces with stub/local impls now (Gemini drops in later via an API key). Structured JSON logging with the correlation chain across all stages. Matches sibling horoscope Maven/Lombok/dotenv conventions; uses port 8090. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema + compose + Postgres). Independent of FEAT-002's code, but shares the HTTP contract documented in FEAT-001.
steps: Create docmind/api-java as a Maven project mirroring horoscope's structure: mvnw/mvnw.cmd/.mvn wrapper, pom.xml with parent spring-boot-starter-parent 4.0.0, groupId com.example, artifactId docmind-api, java.version 21. Dependencies: spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-validation, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, org.postgresql:postgresql, org.flywaydb:flyway-core and flyway-database-postgresql, com.pgvector:pgvector (JDBC vector type helper) OR map vector via String/JDBC if the helper is awkward, org.apache.tika:tika-core (magic-byte MIME detection), lombok (optional, with annotation-processor paths in maven-compiler-plugin exactly like horoscope), me.paulschwarz:spring-dotenv, spring-boot-starter-test (test). Configure spring-boot-maven-plugin excluding lombok. Add a .dockerignore and .gitignore (or rely on FEAT-001 root .gitignore).

Create src/main/resources/application.properties following horoscope style: spring.application.name=docmind-api, server.port=8090, spring.datasource.url=${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5433/docmind}, username/password env-backed with defaults (docmind/docmind), spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate (Flyway owns schema), spring.flyway.enabled=true, docmind.doc-service.base-url=${DOC_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8091}, docmind.doc-service.timeout-ms, gemini.api.keys=${GEMINI_API_KEYS:} + gemini.model with defaults, docmind.chat.top-k, multipart max-file-size/max-request-size. Set logging to JSON (logback-spring.xml with a JSON encoder, or structured appender).

Create Flyway migration src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql: table documents(id uuid pk, filename, sha256 unique, mime, pages int, status, created_at, stats_json jsonb); table blocks(id uuid pk, document_id fk, page int, block_order int, type text, text, markdown, html, latex, bbox jsonb or double precision[4], confidence real, heading_path text[], parse_engine text, parse_version text); table chunks(id uuid pk, document_id fk, heading_path text[], source_block_ids uuid[], page int, bbox jsonb, text, embedding vector(384), tsv tsvector). Add GIN index on chunks.tsv and an ivfflat/hnsw index on chunks.embedding (guard with a comment that pgvector index needs the extension from FEAT-001 init SQL). Indexes on blocks.document_id and chunks.document_id. Choose embedding dim 384 to match paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2; document the choice.

Create entity/ JPA entities (DocumentEntity, BlockEntity, ChunkEntity) and repository/ Spring Data repositories. Map the vector + tsvector columns pragmatically (e.g. @Column(columnDefinition="vector(384)") with a converter, or native queries for the vector/tsv-specific operations). Keep entities clean per project conventions; DTOs separate.

Create dto/ request+response records: DocumentUploadResponse (document_id, job_id, status), DocumentStatusResponse (status, pages, engine_breakdown), ChatRequest (document_id(s), question, top_k optional with @Valid constraints), ChatResponse (answer, citations[] where a Citation carries block_id/chunk_id, page, bbox, heading_path, snippet).

Create client/DocServiceClient (interface) + client/RestDocServiceClient using Spring 6/Boot 4 RestClient: submitParse(file, correlationId) -> returns {job_id, document_id}; getJob(jobId, correlationId) -> status/progress; getResult(jobId, correlationId) -> canonical Document JSON mapped to Java DTOs. Propagate an X-Correlation-Id header on every call (generate one per upload if absent) and set a connect/read timeout from config. Log stage=submit-parse / poll-job with the correlation id. Map the Python canonical JSON to Java model classes mirroring the canonical schema.

Create config/ beans: RestClient bean (base-url from config, timeouts), CorsConfig (match horoscope if a frontend is expected), and a correlation-id filter/interceptor (OncePerRequestFilter) that reads or generates X-Correlation-Id and puts document_id/job_id/correlation_id into the SLF4J MDC so every log line carries the chain.

Create service/DocumentService: handle upload — Tika magic-byte MIME detection (reject on mismatch/unsupported), SHA-256 hashing, persist a documents row (status=PARSING), call DocServiceClient.submitParse, store job_id, and expose an async poll (scheduled or on-demand) that pulls the result when ready, then persists blocks + builds chunks (chunk by heading_path/structure, inheriting document_id/heading_path/source block_ids/page/bbox), computes embeddings via EmbeddingClient, and writes tsvector via SQL. Log stages validate/detect-mime/normalize/chunk/embed with durations.

Create service/llm/LlmClient (interface: complete(prompt, params)->answer) with StubLlmClient (returns a deterministic templated answer citing the retrieved chunks) now, plus a GeminiLlmClient skeleton guarded so it activates only when gemini.api.keys is non-empty (throws/falls back to stub otherwise). Create service/embedding/EmbeddingClient (interface: embed(text|batch)->float[384]) with a StubEmbeddingClient producing deterministic pseudo-vectors (hash-seeded, L2-normalized) so retrieval math runs with no model; add a TODO + skeleton for a real sentence-transformers-backed impl (could call out to Python or an in-JVM ONNX later). Select impls via config/@ConditionalOnProperty.

Create service/retrieval: hybrid retrieval over chunks — vector search (pgvector cosine distance ORDER BY embedding <=> query) + BM25-ish full-text (tsvector @@ plainto_tsquery with ts_rank) via native queries; fuse with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Log stage=retrieve (candidate counts per arm) and stage=rerank (fused order). Build the prompt from top-k fused chunks and call LlmClient; attach citations tracing back to block_ids/page/bbox/heading_path. Add a citation-validate step that confirms each returned citation references a chunk actually retrieved; log stage=citation-validate. This whole path is Java-only and never calls the Python service.

Create controller/DocumentController: POST /api/documents (multipart MultipartFile -> DocumentService.upload -> 201 DocumentUploadResponse), GET /api/documents/{id} (DocumentStatusResponse). Create controller/ChatController: POST /api/chat (@Valid ChatRequest -> retrieval+rerank+LLM -> ChatResponse). Thin controllers delegating to services, per conventions. Create exception/GlobalExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) returning consistent error bodies (timestamp,status,message/errors) for validation (400), not-found (404), unsupported-media/validation failures, and generic 500 — mirroring horoscope.

Create src/main/java/com/example/docmind/DocmindApiApplication.java (@SpringBootApplication) and a health check (actuator optional, or a simple /api/health). Create docmind/api-java/Dockerfile mirroring horoscope's two-stage build (maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 build -> eclipse-temurin:21-jre runtime, EXPOSE 8090). Create .env.example additions already covered in FEAT-001 root; add src/main/resources note if needed.

Create tests under src/test/java: a @WebMvcTest for DocumentController (mock DocumentService) asserting POST /api/documents validates and returns 201; a @WebMvcTest for ChatController asserting POST /api/chat with a stub retrieval+StubLlmClient returns an answer + citations; a unit test for the RRF fusion function (deterministic ranking); a unit test for SHA-256 + Tika MIME detection on sample bytes. Use @MockBean for the DocServiceClient and DB-touching services so `mvnw test` runs without a live Postgres. Keep an @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment=NONE) context-load test guarded so it does not require a DB connection (or exclude DataSource autoconfig in the test profile).
acceptance_criteria: `mvnw.cmd -q -DskipTests package` compiles the project with Spring Boot 4.0.0 + Java 21.
`mvnw.cmd -q test` passes: controller slice tests for /api/documents and /api/chat, the RRF unit test, and the SHA-256/MIME test — all without requiring a running Postgres or any ML model.
POST /api/documents accepts multipart, rejects a file whose magic bytes do not match an allowed type (Tika-based, not extension-based), computes SHA-256, and returns 201 with document_id + job_id.
The DocServiceClient sends X-Correlation-Id on every call to the Python service and the same correlation id appears in Java log lines (via MDC) across validate/submit-parse/poll stages.

Flyway V1__init.sql creates documents/blocks/chunks with a pgvector vector(384) column on chunks and a tsvector column with a GIN index; blocks/chunks have document_id foreign-key indexes; schema fields match docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md.

POST /api/chat runs the Java-only path: hybrid retrieval + RRF rerank + prompt + StubLlmClient, returning an answer plus citations that carry block/chunk id, page, bbox, and heading_path; a citation-validate stage logs and the path never calls the Python service.
LlmClient and EmbeddingClient are interfaces with stub impls active by default; the Gemini impl is wired to activate only when gemini.api.keys is set.
verification: cd docmind/api-java && mvnw.cmd -q test  (all tests green, no DB/model required).
Inspect src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql for vector(384), tsvector + GIN index, and FK indexes. Confirm server.port=8090 in application.properties.

Optional full-system (needs Docker + FEAT-002): docker compose up; curl POST /api/documents with a sample file (201), GET /api/documents/{id} until parsed, POST /api/chat and confirm answer+citations; confirm the X-Correlation-Id propagates into doc-service-py logs.
findings:
api-java (Spring Boot 4.0.0 + Java 21 orchestrator) implemented & verified on Windows (JDK 21.0.9, mvnw 3.9.14 wrapper copied from horoscope, distributionType=only-script). VERIFICATION: `mvnw.cmd -q -DskipTests package` -> BUILD SUCCESS (fat jar target/docmind-api-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar). `mvnw.cmd -q test` -> exit 0, 18 tests green with NO running Postgres and NO ML model: DocumentControllerTest (@WebMvcTest, 2), ChatControllerTest (@WebMvcTest, 3 incl. 400 validation), ChatServiceTest (StubLlmClient + mocked RetrievalService -> answer+citations, 1), ChunkBuilderTest (3), FileValidationTest (SHA-256 known vectors + Tika magic-byte PDF-as-.txt + PNG + ELF reject, 5), ReciprocalRankFusionTest (3), DocmindApiApplicationTests (@SpringBootTest webEnvironment=NONE, profile 'test', context loads with stub LLM+embedding and NO DB connection, 1). (Mockito self-attach JDK warning is benign.)

SPRING BOOT 4 GOTCHAS DISCOVERED (important for future Java work in this repo):
1) Jackson 3 migration: Boot 4 pulls tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind:3.0.2. The auto-configured ObjectMapper bean is tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper (NOT com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper, which is only a transitive 2.20.1 with no bean). Use tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper + tools.jackson.core.JacksonException (unchecked). Jackson ANNOTATIONS stay in com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation (@JsonProperty/@JsonIgnoreProperties unchanged).
2) @WebMvcTest moved to org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest and requires an explicit test dep org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-webmvc-test (not transitively in spring-boot-starter-test). @MockBean is REMOVED; use org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean.
3) ClientHttpRequestFactorySettings/Builder are NOT on the starter-web classpath in 4.0.0; configured RestClient timeouts via spring-web core org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory + JDK HttpClient connectTimeout instead.
4) @ConditionalOnProperty(name=keys) treats an EMPTY value (keys=) as PRESENT, so it cannot express 'non-empty'. Gemini activation uses a custom Condition (GeminiEnabledCondition) that trims the CSV; StubLlmClient uses GeminiEnabledCondition.Disabled. Default (GEMINI_API_KEYS empty) => StubLlmClient active; set keys => GeminiLlmClient becomes @Primary.

SCHEMA (V1__init.sql, matches docs/canonical-schema.md): CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector (idempotent guard); documents(id uuid pk, filename, sha256 unique, mime, pages, status[PARSING|READY|FAILED], job_id, stats_json jsonb, created_at, updated_at); blocks(id uuid pk, document_id fk->documents ON DELETE CASCADE, page, block_order, type, text, markdown, html, latex nullable, bbox double precision[], confidence real, heading_path text[], parse_engine, parse_version); chunks(id uuid pk, document_id fk ON DELETE CASCADE, heading_path text[], source_block_ids uuid[], page, bbox double precision[], text, embedding vector(384), tsv tsvector). Indexes: idx_blocks_document_id, idx_blocks_doc_order, idx_chunks_document_id (FK indexes), idx_chunks_tsv (GIN on tsv), idx_chunks_embedding (ivfflat vector_cosine_ops lists=100). Embedding dim 384 chosen to match paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (multilingual, CPU-friendly). server.port=8090.

CHAT PATH IS JAVA-ONLY (never calls doc-service-py): RetrievalService runs 2 arms via ChunkRepositoryCustomImpl native SQL — vector arm `embedding <=> CAST(? AS vector)` cosine (score=1-distance), full-text arm `tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',?)` with ts_rank — fused by ReciprocalRankFusion (1/(k+rank), k default 60, deterministic tie-break by chunkId). PromptBuilder builds numbered-context prompt; LlmClient.complete() (stub/Gemini). Citations carry chunk_id/document_id/block_ids/page/bbox/heading_path/snippet; a citation-validate stage drops any citation not tracing to a retrieved chunk (logged stage=citation-validate). pgvector mapped pragmatically: chunks' embedding/tsv are written via native INSERT with CAST(? AS vector) + to_tsvector('simple', text) (vector literal '[...]'); ChunkEntity does NOT JPA-map those two columns. tsvector uses 'simple' config to stay language-neutral (docs may be Vietnamese).

INGEST: DocumentController POST /api/documents (multipart field 'file') -> DocumentService.upload: Tika magic-byte MIME detection (FileValidation, allow-list, rejects on mismatch -> 415) + SHA-256 (dedup by sha256), persist documents(status=PARSING), RestDocServiceClient.submitParse (RestClient, propagates X-Correlation-Id from MDC/CorrelationIdFilter) -> stores job_id, returns 201 {document_id, job_id, status}. @Async pollAndPersistAsync polls GET /v1/jobs/{id} until succeeded then GET .../result, persists blocks verbatim + ChunkBuilder groups blocks by (page,heading_path) with union bbox + EmbeddingClient embeds + native chunk insert; stages validate/detect-mime/submit-parse/poll-job/normalize/chunk/embed logged. GET /api/documents/{id} -> status/pages/engine_breakdown. doc-service contract consumed per FEAT-002 findings (POST /v1/parse 202 {job_id,document_id,cached}; GET /v1/jobs/{id}; GET /v1/jobs/{id}/result canonical Document). CorrelationIdFilter (OncePerRequestFilter, highest precedence) reads/generates X-Correlation-Id into MDC and echoes it on the response; logback-spring.xml uses ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.JsonEncoder (built into Boot, withMDC=true) so every line is JSON carrying correlation_id/document_id/job_id/stage.

LLM/EMBEDDING behind interfaces with stub impls active by default (StubLlmClient deterministic templated answer; StubEmbeddingClient hash-seeded L2-normalized 384-dim pseudo-vector so cosine math runs with no model). GeminiLlmClient skeleton (round-robin key, generativelanguage v1beta generateContent, graceful fallback on error) becomes @Primary only when gemini.api.keys non-empty. EmbeddingClient has a TODO to swap in a real sentence-transformers/ONNX impl (via @ConditionalOnMissingBean(name="primaryEmbeddingClient")).

Docker: api-java/Dockerfile two-stage (maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 build with dependency:go-offline cache layer -> eclipse-temurin:21-jre runtime, EXPOSE 8090) mirroring horoscope minus the Node/iztro bits. .dockerignore added. Env/config via ${ENV:default}; .env.example already provided by FEAT-001 (DOC_SERVICE_BASE_URL, SPRING_DATASOURCE_*, GEMINI_API_KEYS, DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL). target/ is gitignored by FEAT-001 root .gitignore. Full-system docker test (needs Docker + FEAT-002 running) left as optional per verification section.
